aus-page-4.webp.en: The entrance monument and fountain at Austin-Bergstrom — the airport's name and mark lit at dusk.

aus-page-5.webp.zh: 芭芭拉·乔丹航站楼内景：旅客拖着行李经过「C Gates 1–25」指示牌与航班信息屏。
aus-page-5.webp.en: Inside the Barbara Jordan Terminal — travellers with bags passing the "C Gates 1–25" sign and departure screens.

aus-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 航站楼大厅里，旅客拖着行李箱走向登机口，头顶悬挂着黄色的登机口指示牌。
aus-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Under the "BARBARA JORDAN TERMINAL" wall lettering, passengers haul rolling bags toward the gates.

aus-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 俯瞰航站楼与机坪：多架客机停在廊桥旁，停车场与在建工程环绕四周。
aus-chatgpt-02.webp.en: An aerial view of the terminal and apron, where jets fill the jet bridges beside packed car parks and a building site.

aus-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 夜幕下的机坪上，客机停在廊桥前，航站楼灯光映在深蓝色的天幕下。
aus-chatgpt-03.webp.en: At night on the apron, an airliner waits at its jet bridge as terminal lights glow beneath a deep blue sky.

aus-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 候机长廊里，旅客在餐饮店旁用餐，落地窗把机坪的日光洒满地面。
aus-chatgpt-04.webp.en: In the departure concourse, travellers eat beside food stands as daylight from the tall windows floods the polished floor.

aus-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 远处的机场全景：跑道与滑行道在草地间铺开，航站楼和塔台散布其中。
aus-chatgpt-05.webp.en: A distant aerial of the airfield, its runways and taxiways cutting across open grassland with the terminal and tower far off.

aus-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 两架客机并排停靠在灰色航站楼前，机身尾翼的红白蓝涂装十分醒目。
aus-chatgpt-06.webp.en: Two airliners sit side by side before the grey terminal, their red, white and blue tail liveries bright in the sun.

aus-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 这是一张航站楼安检区的建筑效果图：木格栅吊顶下排着隔离带，墙上有彩色壁画。
aus-chatgpt-07.webp.en: An architectural rendering of a terminal security hall, with a wood-slat ceiling, queue barriers and colourful murals along the walls.
